title: Wall Mount Ladder Towel Bar, 30-Inch Center-to-Center, 4-Tier Solid Brass | Carolina Collection Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your towel storage with a wall mount ladder towel bar that makes efficient use of space, featuring a 30-Inch center-to-center span and four bars for organized drying in the Carolina collection.

  • Traditional styling: Designed to coordinate with classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures.
  • 4-tier ladder design: Four horizontal bars provide plenty of room for towels at varying heights.
  • Solid brass construction: Crafted of solid brass with a durable designer finish.
  • Clean installation: Concealed screw mounting hardware for a refined wall-mounted look.
  • Coordinated bath: Pair with matching Carolina collection accessories for consistent traditional bathroom hardware.

Specs

  • Center-to-center: 30 in
  • Overall dimensions: 30 in L x 35 in H
  • Projection (depth): 3.3 in
  • Bar diameter: 0.75 in
  • Weight capacity: 20 lb
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Ladder towel bar and all installation hardware (screws: #8 x 1 1/4")
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
  • Finish options: Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement colors

_previous.description: The traditional styling of this ladder towel bar from the Allied Brass Carolina Collection is a perfect addition to any bathroom. The 4 horizontal bars at varying heights make it fun to stack your favorite towels while allowing this accessory to be user friendly at all heights. Not only is this ladder towel bar an efficient use of space, it is unique and highly sophisticated and stylish. Coordinate this item with some matching accessories from Allied Brass to complete your design.
